ck_app_user_local_needs_password.name: ck_app_user_local_needs_password
ck_app_user_local_needs_password.value: auth_provider <> 'local' OR password_hash IS NOT NULL

ck_ticket_source_device_valid.name: ck_ticket_source_device_valid
ck_ticket_source_device_valid.value: source_device IS NULL OR source_device IN ('web', 'mobile_web')

ck_ticket_pending_reason_valid.name: ck_ticket_pending_reason_valid
ck_ticket_pending_reason_valid.value: pending_reason IS NULL OR pending_reason IN ('user', 'vendor', 'approval')

ck_ticket_sla_exclusion_valid.name: ck_ticket_sla_exclusion_valid
ck_ticket_sla_exclusion_valid.value: sla_exclusion_code IS NULL OR sla_exclusion_code IN ('planned_maintenance', 'force_majeure', 'vendor_delay', 'user_installed', 'waiting_requester', 'agreed_special_terms')

ck_ticket_satisfaction_range.name: ck_ticket_satisfaction_range
ck_ticket_satisfaction_range.value: satisfaction_score IS NULL OR satisfaction_score BETWEEN 1 AND 5

ck_ticket_pending_needs_reason.name: ck_ticket_pending_needs_reason
ck_ticket_pending_needs_reason.value: status <> 'pending_user' OR pending_reason IS NOT NULL

ck_ticket_service_request_needs_catalog.name: ck_ticket_service_request_needs_catalog
ck_ticket_service_request_needs_catalog.value: ticket_type <> 'service_request' OR catalog_item_id IS NOT NULL

ck_ticket_tier3_needs_vendor_ref.name: ck_ticket_tier3_needs_vendor_ref
ck_ticket_tier3_needs_vendor_ref.value: support_tier <> 3 OR vendor_ref IS NOT NULL

ck_service_outage_order.name: ck_service_outage_order
ck_service_outage_order.value: ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at > started_at

ck_approval_reject_needs_comment.name: ck_approval_reject_needs_comment
ck_approval_reject_needs_comment.value: status <> 'rejected' OR comment IS NOT NULL

ck_approval_decided_complete.name: ck_approval_decided_complete
ck_approval_decided_complete.value: status NOT IN ('approved','rejected') OR (decided_by IS NOT NULL AND decided_at IS NOT NULL)

ck_catalog_duration_needs_minutes.name: ck_catalog_duration_needs_minutes
ck_catalog_duration_needs_minutes.value: target_mode <> 'duration' OR target_minutes IS NOT NULL

ck_catalog_approval_needs_chain.name: ck_catalog_approval_needs_chain
ck_catalog_approval_needs_chain.value: requires_approval = false OR approval_chain IS NOT NULL

ck_checklist_item_evidence_when_done.name: ck_checklist_item_evidence_when_done
ck_checklist_item_evidence_when_done.value: NOT (is_done AND evidence_required AND attachment_id IS NULL)

ck_checklist_item_done_complete.name: ck_checklist_item_done_complete
ck_checklist_item_done_complete.value: NOT is_done OR (done_by IS NOT NULL AND done_at IS NOT NULL)

ck_kb_published_needs_date.name: ck_kb_published_needs_date
ck_kb_published_needs_date.value: status <> 'published' OR published_at IS NOT NULL
